Path: off the road — a dormant exported face | 缺项 (`StrictAnyComponentSchema` refuses a correctly authored `metric-card`) | P3

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue`. Direction: the strict slot arm admits the card's registered inputs

Triage: lands in `packages/types/src/strict-authoring-face.ts` (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`, `:358` on `origin/main`), the types/zod contract face ⇒ `domain:spec`. The cross-repo rule sends the contract face to that lane, as it did objectui#8344.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-28T20:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p3.** The face has no non-test consumer in this repository, so no shipped path is broken. It is exported, so a downstream author who validates with it is refused on a correct dashboard. That is wrong published behaviour (NORTH-STAR rule 4), but off the road and dormant.

**Direction.**
- The strict widget-slot arm admits the keys a component's registration declares as inputs, so `value` is admitted on `metric-card`. It still refuses a key that no registration declares.
- Fix the derivation, not the one card. The measurement says the derived strict slot arm closes the passthrough whose members are the registry inputs, so any other card with required inputs is in the same position. Census that in the same PR.
- **Pins:** `{ type: 'metric-card', value: 42 }` parses under `StrictAnyComponentSchema`, and `{ type: 'metric-card', bogus: 1 }` is still refused by name.

**The related observation does not join this card.** The legacy widget envelope's `component` is plain `BaseSchema` by design (objectui#8344's note), and objectstack-ai/objectstack#8593's ruling declined the `AnyComponentSchema` redirect. No reach was measured for it, so it gets no card of its own.

Claim: PM loop round 8
Session: `session_012UwY3ahMixEFkfTUxMVkYm`
Account: `huangyiirene` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)

File surface: the strict widget-slot arm's derivation behind `StrictAnyComponentSchema` (`packages/types/src/strict-authoring-face.ts`, and the slot arm's source under `packages/types/src/zod/` if the derivation lives there), so that each card's registered inputs are admitted and an undeclared key is still refused by name. Plus a census of every other card with registered inputs in the same position, pins under `packages/types/src/__tests__/`, and one `.changeset/*.md`. Stop on breach and explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: yes — the strict face's accept set widens: a correctly authored `metric-card` (and any other card whose registered inputs the closed arm refused) now parses; an undeclared key is still refused.
Thread-read: 5878357772
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `strict-authoring-face.ts` (files API, all 4 open PRs, `main` `797a30f48`). This seat's own PR #10930 (objectui#4356, held) edits the `GlobalFilterSchema` docblock in `zod/complex.zod.ts`. That is a disjoint region if the slot arm's source is there too.

  - ③ (c) **Census.** `metric-card` is the only member in that position, and the pin re-derives that on every run.
- **Recorded limit, not a defect at population one.** The record flattens the whole closed set onto one arm. If `DASHBOARD_COMPONENT_WIDGET_TYPES` gains a second member, that member would be admitted the first member's inputs. The `complex.ts` docblock and this note are for whoever adds that member.

  - Anchor: objectui#11024. Stand-down note: `5879410182`.
- **Governed surface.** None.

- the legacy envelope's strict refusal, which the grade ruled out;
- the 45 root rows, carried by objectui#10872 and objectui#4631;
- `loading` / `error`, refused by the grade's own rule;
